plan.title: Prepare a reproducible local release candidate and document installation and migration evidence

criteria.description: Detected-stack initialization starts with missing evidence and refuses accidental overwrite; execute an isolated candidate installation, init, check, status and stale smoke and record exact results.
Unknown stacks cannot create passing placeholder checks.
The executable lifecycle preserves actual execution results; candidate artifacts have verified SHA256 sums, explicit source revision and truthful platform support documentation.

limitations: Prepare candidates in a temporary directory only; no system installation, push, tags, publishing or settings changes.
Cross-compilation is not runtime validation; Windows runtime and full Go 1.23 suite remain unverified.
Review English and Korean installation guidance, migration, changelog and public artifact contents; record independent-review status separately in NARU-022.
